production_rules: One attendance report renders exactly two images: overview first, detail second.
Overview prioritizes large KPI cards, a large attendance-rate visual, and large horizontal work-hour bars.
Detail uses one full-width employee card per person so names and shift data remain readable on mobile.
Daily detail visually separates morning in blue and afternoon in green.
All names, times, durations, totals and statuses come only from the canonical attendance business report.
Missing or unresolved values are never inferred.
No external images, remote fonts, AI-generated text, or logo are used by the deterministic renderer.
Teams delivery uses two native hostedContents in the same message.
